sql_templates.description: Fetch latest market context based on FII DII flows, regime, and breadth.
sql_templates.name: get_latest_market_context
sql_templates.template:
WITH latest_date AS (
                    SELECT MAX(trade_date) as max_date FROM signals.fii_dii_flows
                )
                SELECT f.trade_date, f.flow_signal, f.fii_trend, f.dii_trend, 
                       r.regime, r.confidence, r.days_in_regime, 
                       b.market_sentiment, b.bullish_pct, b.bearish_pct, 
                       i.index_symbol, i.close, i.trend_signal
                FROM signals.fii_dii_flows f
                JOIN signals.regime_history r 
                ON f.trade_date = r.trade_date
                JOIN breadth.market_daily b
                ON f.trade_date = b.trade_date
                JOIN market.index_eod i
                ON f.trade_date = i.trade_date
                AND i.index_symbol = 'Nifty 50'
                WHERE f.trade_date = (SELECT max_date FROM latest_date);

synthesis_guidance: ['Explain how FII/DII trends and market regime indicators interact.', 'Contextualize the breadth signals and relate them to risk-on or risk-off insights.', 'Integrate index confirmation to solidify the market outlook.']
